inputs.name: github_url
inputs.description: Repository, organization or enterprise the runners register with, such as "https://github.com/acme/app" or "https://github.com/acme".

inputs.name: register
inputs.description: Register runners that aren't registered yet, with registration_token. Set it to false once they are, so later plans don't need a token.

inputs.name: registration_token
inputs.description: Registration token from GitHub's "New self-hosted runner" page or its API. It expires after an hour. Required when register is true.

inputs.name: runners
inputs.description: Runners to run on each host, by key. name defaults to HOST-KEY, labels are added to self-hosted, Linux and X64 or ARM64, and group is an organization's runner group.

inputs.name: runner_version
inputs.description: actions/runner release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release tarball for each architecture, x86_64 and aarch64, from the release notes. Change these with runner_version.

inputs.name: auto_update
inputs.description: Let each runner update itself when GitHub releases a new version. When false, update by raising runner_version, and do it within 30 days of each release or GitHub stops sending jobs.

inputs.name: user
inputs.description: System user the runners and their jobs run as. The circuit creates it, without sudo.

inputs.name: install_dir
inputs.description: Directory that holds the tarball and one directory per runner.
